note: Both sets extract the same core Table 6-1 values correctly (TwFAStif, TwSSStif, TwGJStif, TwEAStif, TwFAIner, TwSSIner at the base and top rows, plus the 347,460 kg integrated tower mass), with no misread or misbound values in either. Set B adds two extra correct claims (TwFAcgOf and TwSScgOf = 0.0 m at Elevation 87.60 m), but these are trivial zero-value entries of little engineering use. Both sets repeat nearly every fact two or three times (under unit variants like kg•m vs kg*m and with/without HtFract), and both omit the TMassDen column entirely and the tower mass center at 38.234 m. Given equal correctness and equal duplication, the two extra trivial claims in B do not make it meaningfully better.
remarks: Both sets omit the entire TMassDen (kg/m) column of Table 6-1 and the statement that the integrated tower mass is centered at 38.234 m (sentence is cut off in the text layer but the value is legible). Each set states most facts 2-3 times, differing only in unit notation (kg•m vs kg*m, N•m2 vs N*m^2) or in whether HtFract is included in conditions — effectively the same claim under two names. Many quotes are reconstructed with '...' rather than literal contiguous text, though the values they point to are correct.
